intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Clovis for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Holiday Horse-Drawn Carriage Rides in Old Town Clovis) through December 20, with Sensory Santa (December 5 and 19), the City Hall Christmas Tree Lighting (December 7), the Merry Mile on the Old Town Trail (December 12) and Here Comes Santa Claus (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Clovis

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Clovis
  • 5 free events, including the City Hall Christmas Tree Lighting, the Merry Mile on the Old Town Trail and free carriage rides
  • Meet Santa: Here Comes Santa Claus at the Clovis Veterans Memorial District (December 13) and Sensory Santa at We Rock The Spectrum (December 5 and 19)
  • Parades and lights: the Children's Electric Christmas Parade and the City Hall tree lighting (December 7)
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 20, 2026
